name: Parliament Connect
description:
Parliament Connect turns the UK Parliament video record into something you can ask a question of. Describe an idea in plain language, or give the distinctive words you remember, and it returns the clips where those things were actually said in the Commons chamber.

Every result comes back with the speaker, their party, the sitting date, an excerpt of the transcript the match was made against, and links to the clip — a public one that plays the video for anyone you send it to, and a private one that opens it in your shared Clip Library.

Matching runs against the spoken transcript only, never the AI-written titles or descriptions attached to a clip. That matters: the half-remembered sentence is the thing to type. Two modes are available — full-text for distinctive wording or a name, and semantic for when you know the idea but not the phrasing. A second tool pulls a single clip's complete transcript once you have found it.

It is built for people who need the footage rather than the summary: MPs' offices answering correspondence, journalists sourcing a quote before filing, and public affairs teams tracking what was said about a policy or a constituency.

Everything the connector does is read-only. It cannot create, edit, publish, schedule or delete anything in your account. Searching covers the MPs your Parliament Connect plan includes, and coverage is House of Commons chamber sessions — no Lords, no select committees, no Westminster Hall.

You sign in once with an existing Parliament Connect account. There is no API key to generate and no separate purchase: it is the library your plan already has, reached from the chat window instead of the browser.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Parliament Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Parliament Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://parliamentconnect.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Parliament Connect MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Parliament Connect provides these MCP tools: fetch, parliament_connect_search_clips, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Parliament Connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Parliament Connect in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.

_published_faq.name: Does Parliament Connect MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Parliament Connect requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Parliament Connect is developed by Veedoo Mobility OÜ. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
